title: On Venus, which is longer: a day or a year?
subtitle: Guess whether a day or a year lasts longer on Venus, then hear why it spins so slowly, and backwards, so that the Sun rises in the west.
notes: Venus + red marker moved round the orbit in one move (path + rotate −333° about Venus): one lap, not quite one turn. Ends on 'sunrise to sunrise: 117 d'.
